t0015-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0015-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0015-02.gloss: A hurried request links an unnamed person to watered rows.
t0015-02.rival_reading: An emergency crew could tell someone to reach a farm before irrigation resumed; the urgency could follow a road closure rather than a program failure.
